issues.description: Captures any issues that occurred while deserializing from filesystem

credentials.description: Contains the access key and secret key.

defaultGroupId.description: The default group id to add IAM users to.

defaultResourceGroup.description: The ID of the default resource group under which Azure resources are created.

storageAccountPrefix.description:
The prefix to be added to Azure storage account names. Note that maximum length of the overall storage account name is 24 characters consisting
of lowercase characters and numbers.

storageAccountRegion.description: The Azure region to use for the storage account

storageAccountAccessTier.description: The Access Tier to use for the Azure storage account. Possible values are "Hot" and "Cool"
